candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release

blender.clay: One metaball clay family (the blockout recipe) voxel-remeshed at 0.0077 m, thumbprint dimples pressed, a low-frequency CLOUDS Displace applied (soles kept flat); low-poly skin = uniform voxel start shrink-wrapped back onto the clay, then a protected collapse (fists, toes, face) to 10600 triangles, high-resolution shading normals transferred
blender.skin: Bone-heat (automatic) weights on the continuous clay body for the 18 body bones (0 fallback vertices), a soft pot-belly squash region (96 vertices), rigid weights on the eyes, brows, tongue, antenna, belt and buckle; limited to 4 influences and normalised
blender.rig: root, hips, spine, belly, chest, head, antenna_root, antenna_1, antenna_2, eye_R, eye_L, tongue, belt, shoulder/upper_arm/forearm/fist x2, thigh/shin/foot x2 (27 joints). The legs hang from the root.
blender.root: Identity, fixed floor-centred root; no root animation; the hips translate for the bounce, waddle, lunge, recoil and the melt
blender.bind_pose: Rig-friendly A-pose rest (head straight, arms relaxed, the sheet bow-legged stance) as the sheet notes suggest; the sheet guard is recreated at idle 0 s and every clip except move starts from it
blender.squash_and_stretch: Bone scale, exported as glTF scale channels. Every basis is exactly T x R x S (max matrix error 7.7e-06). Counter-scaled sockets keep the eyes, the antenna and the fists (under the stretching arms) in shape; the belt keeps its coil thickness in the puddle. Blender-evaluated skin matches three.js skinning to 1.1e-06 m at 5 frames per clip.
blender.guards: Legs are two-bone world IK with an analytic toe or heel pivot; a numeric floor guard skins the exact mesh every frame (linear blend skinning, as three.js does) and lifts the whole pose above a 2.5 mm contact plane when needed (lifts per clip in construction.json floor_guard, all at most 1.6 mm).

materials.0: Matte hand-worked clay (opaque, baked atlas region)
materials.1: Satin blank eyes, tongue and warm-gold buckle (opaque, flat atlas tiles)

export.compression: None; no Draco, Meshopt or KTX2 requirement

preview.source: Exact delivered GLB via Three.js GLTFLoader
preview.renderer: Chromium headless ANGLE SwiftShader, real WebGL raster; no physical device claim
preview.gameplay_camera: Perspective 48 deg, 7.9 m out and 2.62 m high at azimuths 0/45/90/180/-90 deg, looking at 0.9 m
preview.lighting: Warm hemisphere plus three directional lights; ACES tone mapping exposure 1.0
